h: Egungun of Lagos thanks Zlatan Ibile for the money that bought his first costume
p: The performer known as the Egungun of Lagos has reportedly said Zlatan gave him money seven years ago to buy his first costume. He shared the message around the rapper's wedding, and fans praised the gesture.
more: Zlatan's traditional wedding has dominated entertainment chatter this weekend.
Many fans say the story shows the rapper's generosity.
